parties.respondent: M/s ECI SPIC SMO MCML (JV) A Joint Venture Company

summary: Constitution Bench reference on arbitral tribunal independence; interplay between party autonomy and mandatory principles; equality under Section 18; nemo judex rule applied to arbitrator appointments; unilateral appointment violates equality clause; automatic disqualification for listed relationships per Section 12(5) and Seventh Schedule; mandatory principles override prior agreements; unconscionability in public-private contracts; minimum judicial interference upheld;
final_judgment: Constitution Bench reference decided; certain arbitrator appointment procedures invalidated; principles of independence and impartiality upheld as mandatory overriding party autonomy.
